name: Appalachian Highlands TN 2024
information:
We are happy to bring the first WCA competition to Johnson City, TN! 
There will be plenty of **FREE** parking at the ETSU Brinkley Center Parking Garage located at 2004 Millennium Pl, Johnson City, TN 37604.
#### DO NOT PARK ON LEVELS 1 OR 2 AS THOSE ARE RESERVED FOR THE HOTEL! YOU WILL GET TOWED IF YOU DO NOT PARK ON LEVELS 3-6!
